gloss: to get hungry; to be hungry

definitions.gloss: to get hungry; to feel hungry
definitions.explanation: The everyday way to say one is hungry. The past form お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いた describes the present state, "I'm hungry"; the ている form お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いている says the same thing as a description.

examples.japanese: ⟦ああ→ああ：01147_aa⟧、お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いた。
⟦{走|はし}ったら→走る：00519_hashiru⟧お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いてきた。
お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧おいしく⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: When you're hungry, anything tastes good.

notes:
Often written in kana, おなかがすく. The verb is {空|す}く (to become empty), written with the same kanji as ⟦{空|あ}く→空く：11062_aku⟧ (to become vacant). In speech the ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ often drops: ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧{空|す}いた.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぺこぺこ→ぺこぺこ：05161_pekopeko⟧だ: to be starving
- お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いて⟦{死|し}に→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧そう: so hungry I could die (casual exaggeration)
- お{腹|なか}が{空|す}いたら⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: tell me when you get hungry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: to get hungry — blunter, used mostly by men
- ⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧: hunger, an empty stomach — written and formal
